title: Expert part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a single loop with ten lines. Start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0561, 0.0). Continue with the second line from (0.0561, 0.0) to (0.0561, 0.0879), then the third line from (0.0561, 0.0879) to (0.0502, 0.0879). Draw the fourth line from (0.0502, 0.0879) to (0.0502, 0.0584), followed by the fifth line from (0.0502, 0.0584) to (0.0, 0.0584). Add the sixth line from (0.0, 0.0584) to (0.0, 0.0556), then the seventh line from (0.0, 0.0556) to (0.0502, 0.0556). Draw the eighth line from (0.0502, 0.0556) to (0.0502, 0.0028), followed by the ninth line from (0.0502, 0.0028) to (0.0, 0.0028). Finally, draw the tenth line from (0.0, 0.0028) back to the origin (0.0, 0.0). Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0879. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector of zeros. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The resulting expert part has a length of 0.05613207547169811, a width of 0.08787416745283019, and a height of 0.75 units.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
wp = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch points
points = [
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (0.0561, 0.0),
    (0.0561, 0.0879),
    (0.0502, 0.0879),
    (0.0502, 0.0584),
    (0.0, 0.0584),
    (0.0, 0.0556),
    (0.0502, 0.0556),
    (0.0502, 0.0028),
    (0.0, 0.0028),
    (0.0, 0.0)
]

# Create the sketch
sketch = wp.polyline(points).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = extrusion

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Dimensions
web_len = 0.0879      # web length along Y
flange_len = 0.0561   # flange length along X
t = 0.012             # material thickness
height = 0.7500       # extrusion along Z

# Channel cross-section: web at right (x = flange_len), flanges pointing left
profile = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(flange_len, 0)
    .lineTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(0, t)
    .lineTo(flange_len - t, t)
    .lineTo(flange_len - t, web_len - t)
    .lineTo(0, web_len - t)
    .lineTo(0, web_len)
    .lineTo(flange_len, web_len)
    .close()
    .extrude(height)
)

r = profile
